column1: # Eval manifest for eval/run_eval.py
# One row per labeled test clip. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Columns:
#   path          - path to the audio file. Relative paths are resolved against
#                   the repo root (the parent of eval/). Any format ffmpeg can
#                   read (wav/mp3/m4a/ogg/opus/flac/...).
#   gender        - ground-truth speaker gender: male | female
#                   (use "unknown" only if you genuinely cannot tell; such rows
#                    are excluded from gender accuracy)
#   age_bracket   - ground-truth age bracket
#                   (leave blank if you don't have a reliable age; the row is
#                    then excluded from age accuracy but still used for gender)
#   verified      - yes | no. "no" = best-effort label
#                   confirmed. run_eval.py reports verified and unverified
#                   rows both together and separately
#                   labels can't quietly inflate the headline number.
#   notes         - free text
column2: for your own reference. No commas.

column1: # HONEST LIMITATIONS OF THIS SET (read eval/README.md for the full write-up):
